newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says plans to offer 20-year JGBs on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: MOF says plans to offer 20-year JGBs on Tuesday.

text.p: The Finance Ministry plans to offer 20-year Japanese government bonds through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, a ministry official said on Monday.
The offer amount is likely to be left unchanged from the previous 20-year JGB auction held in April, at 400 billion yen, traders said.
The coupon rate is likely to be set at 3.1 percent, up from three percent at the previous auction in April, judging from current market conditions, they said.
